material.title: Die lexikalischen Listen der archaischen Texte aus Uruk
material.responsibility: Robert K. Englund and Hans J. Nissen; unter Mitarbeit von Peter Damerow
material.edition_or_resource: Archaische Texte aus Uruk, Band 3; Ausgrabungen der Deutschen Forschungsgemeinschaft in Uruk-Warka, Band 13; Berlin: Gebr. Mann, 1993
material.requested_portion: Tier 1: exact front matter, table of contents, and current copying/research-use terms. Tier 2, only if lawful: a complete local research copy or reading-room/interlibrary route. If a complete copy cannot be supplied, a bounded representative packet covering the list inventory, one complete lexical-list section, and representative LLATU sign-index pages is acceptable.

research_purpose: Establish exact bibliographic, page, list, and sign-index provenance for the foundational Late Uruk lexical corpus; compare source-visible LLATU coordinates with later DCCLT, PCSL, and Unicode coordinates without collapsing signs, readings, glosses, classifications, or interpretations.
requested_format: Lawful reading-room or interlibrary access, or a source-faithful PDF scan with stable page order and explicit copying, local OCR/transcription, indexing, embedding, quotation, retention, and research-use conditions. No public source-file hosting or redistribution is requested.

local_storage_conditions.retention_posture: Retain only under supplied library or rights conditions; preserve fixity and provenance metadata; keep source bytes local and removable; publish neither the source file nor restricted derivatives.
